selectionEntries.comment: ADDITIONAL COPY COSTS / GS21. Permanent required accounting entry with separate Troops and Other ledgers. Light, Dark, and Twilight Troupes use independent 4 / 6 / 8 Troop normal-copy allowances; Skyweaver, Voidweaver, and Starweaver retain the existing 1 / 2 / 3 Other arithmetic. The parent retains automatic insertion, Required Additional Copy Costs Configuration semantics, linked player-facing rule, and duplicate-entry validation.

selectionEntries.name: Troops
selectionEntries.comment: TROOP COPY-COST LEDGER. Light Troupe, Dark Troupe, and Twilight Troupe are three independent Troop copy families using the current Game System 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance. Each further identical copy costs +20 Points.

selectionEntries.name: Other
selectionEntries.comment: OTHER COPY-COST LEDGER. Contains the 18 pre-existing Skyweaver, Voidweaver, and Starweaver point modifiers unchanged, preserving the established 1 / 2 / 3 allowance.

## Harlequins 3.3.6

*Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server: https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB*

• Catalogue maintenance: current implementation notes and historical comments consolidated for the Harlequins 3.3.6 / GS21 baseline.

catalogue.comment:
CURRENT STATE
Playable Harlequins adapter for Harlequins 3.3.6 on Game System revision 21. All ten playable unit trees are supplied by the linked Harlequins 3.3.6 - Library; this catalogue owns root availability, primary presentation categories, Patch Notes, and standalone Additional Copy Costs accounting.

AUTHORING / RUNTIME NOTES
The library link does not import root entries automatically; the ten stable entryLinks are the playable roster surface. Additional Copy Costs is a permanent required Configuration entry. Its Troops ledger charges +20 Points per identical Light, Dark, or Twilight Troupe beyond the selected Game Size's 4 / 6 / 8 allowance. Its Other ledger preserves the existing Skyweaver, Voidweaver, and Starweaver 1 / 2 / 3 allowance arithmetic unchanged. Duplicate Additional Copy Costs entries use the custom automatic_configuration_duplicate error; missing-entry validation is owned by the Game System Required Additional Copy Costs Configuration semantic.

HISTORICAL REVISION LOG
REV8: New Recruit cost-type compatibility sync. REV9-10: presentation / error-UX companion cleanup. V11: Harlequins 3.3.5 title and standard Patch Notes baseline. V12: Harlequins 3.3.6 and GS21 baseline sync. V13: unified Troops / Other Additional Copy Costs presentation and fixed missing standalone Troop copy surcharges.
